ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that intercepts user prompts in real-time, matching them against an exemplar vector index to dynamically route execution paths and reduce LLM API overhead.
ideas.title: PromptCircuit: Visual Semantic Router for Prompt Workflows
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Dev Tools track by leveraging advanced prompt engineering and semantic routing patterns that won at the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI governance tool that uses BPMN orchestration to pre-screen and audit autonomous agent workflows against Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) environmental impact metrics before deployment.
ideas.title: EcoBPMN: Automated SDG Compliance Risk Diagnosis for AI Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits squarely into both the SDG and Open Innovation tracks by combining compliance governance with AI execution, echoing winning patterns from UiPath AgentHack.

ideas.pitch: A secure clinical data platform using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to bridge isolated electronic health record sources with localized multi-agent diagnostic tools.
ideas.title: MediGraph MCP: Federated Medical Data Clinical Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins the Healthcare track by addressing real-world clinical privacy needs and federated data access, mimicking the runner-up architecture from the MCP & AI Agents Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A local developer tool that runs quantized code analysis and optimization models on embedded NPU hardware to flag latency bottlenecks without sending code to cloud APIs.
ideas.title: EdgeDebug NPU: Offline AI Code Reviewer for Hardware Constraints
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Hardware and Dev Tools tracks by targeting on-device processing and localized execution similar to Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent educational platform that diagnoses student knowledge gaps through iterative quizzes and dynamically rewrites syllabus pathways in real time.
ideas.title: LearnPath AI: Multi-Agent EdTech Syllabus Adaptive Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the EdTech track with a working, closed-loop multi-agent diagnostic loop inspired by the architecture of winning autonomous IoT operations platforms.
